families.logic: Close crosses the Keltner channel boundary (EMA midline +/- mult x ATR14): cross above upper -> long, below lower -> short. Trend-breakout, distinct from Donchian (EMA-centred, vol-scaled). Bracket 2/4 ATR.
Trend-following Bollinger breakout (NOT reversion): close crosses above upper band -> long, below lower band -> short. Bracket 2/4 ATR.
MACD(12,26,9) histogram sign change: up-cross -> long, down-cross -> short. Variant ema200 requires price on the trend side of EMA200; variant raw is unfiltered. Bracket 2.5/5 ATR.
Parabolic SAR (Wilder) flip: SAR crosses below price -> long, above -> short. Bracket 2/4 ATR.
RSI momentum regime (NOT reversion): RSI crosses up through the long threshold -> long; down through the short threshold -> short. Bracket 2/4 ATR.

Stochastic(14,3) %K crosses back up from below 20 -> long; back down from above 80 -> short. Variant filt requires EMA200 trend alignment (longs only above, shorts only below); variant raw unfiltered. Bracket 2/4 ATR.
Tenkan(9)/Kijun(26) cross. Variant cloud requires price above cloud for longs / below for shorts (Senkou spans, causal +26 shift); variant raw ignores the cloud. Bracket 2/4 ATR.
Heikin-Ashi momentum: variant two requires two consecutive HA bull candles with HA-open == HA-low (no lower wick) -> long, mirror -> short; variant one uses a single such candle. Bracket 2/4 ATR.
Rolling OLS of log-close: enter on slope sign change when R^2 > 0.3 (trend-quality filter). Bracket 2.5/5 ATR.
Single-bar shock: close exceeds prior close by > k x ATR14 upward -> long; downward -> short (news/impulse continuation). Bracket 2/4 ATR.

Variant inside_bar: an inside bar followed by a close beyond the mother bar's high/low -> entry in breakout direction. Variant engulfing: bullish/bearish engulfing close -> entry in engulfing direction. Bracket 2/4 ATR.

DAILY ONLY. Gap = open/prev_close - 1 observed at bar i. Variant follow: |gap| > 0.4% -> signal in gap direction at bar i close, entry executes bar i+1 open (next-day continuation, exactly as the harness executes; the gap itself is never traded retroactively). Variant fade: opposite direction. Bracket 2/4 ATR.

DAILY ONLY, long-only calendar effect: enter long on the first bar of the month-turn window, where the window is defined CAUSALLY as the first 3 trading bars of the month or calendar day-of-month >= 28; exit via bracket_time cap of 6 bars, wide bracket 3/6 ATR. (The textbook 'last 3 trading days' variant was rejected pre-run: a truncation causality test proved it look-ahead, since month length is unknown mid-month.)

Cross-sectional short-term REVERSAL (opposite of xs_momentum): rank trailing L-bar returns, long bottom quintile / short top quintile, rebalance every 5 bars, hold 5. Exits bracket_time 2/4 ATR, max_bars = hold.
Low-volatility anomaly: rank trailing 20-bar realized volatility, long lowest quintile / short highest, rebalance every 10 bars, hold 10. Exits bracket_time 2/4 ATR, max_bars = hold.

Identical construction to batch-2 pairs_statarb: log-spread S = logA - beta*logB, beta from causal trailing OLS (window 240); z-score window 48; entries on |z| crossing 2.0; exits bracket_time 3/3 ATR, 96-bar cap, on the synthetic spread series; doubled two-leg costs; returns are log-spread units (disclosed approximation). Three additional liquid crypto pairs.

1H ONLY. Variant london (forex12): range = 07:00 UTC bar high/low; entries 08:00-11:00 UTC on close beyond range, one per day, 6-bar bracket_time cap, bracket 1.5/3 ATR. Variant newyork (idx3): range = 14:00 UTC bar; entries 15:00-18:00 UTC, same exits.

families.logic: Volatility-compression breakout: ATR7 at its 50-bar minimum (NR-style squeeze) AND close beyond prior 10-bar high/low -> entry in breakout direction. Variant ema200 adds trend alignment. Bracket 2/4 ATR.
